intelligence.essence: Spaces & Worlds are intelligent Smart Apps created around shared interests, topics, communities, places, products, projects, and passions. If something matters to you, you can give it a world of its own — a place where people who love the same thing can gather, share, and build together.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you love dogs more than anything, so you build a whole little world just for dog lovers — with pictures of dogs, questions about dogs, and all your dog-loving friends in one place. That's a Space: a world you make around whatever your thing is.
intelligence.grandma_view: Imagine a clubhouse for anything you care about — your cooking, your hometown, a cause close to your heart — where everyone who loves the same thing can meet, share what they know, and look after each other. That's a Space, and you can build one yourself.
